name: gen-x-business-builder
description: Gen X Business Builder - AI Solution Generator Platform

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install && cd ../tests && npm install
scripts.db:migrate: cd server && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:push: cd server && npx prisma db push
scripts.test:e2e:full: cd tests && E2E_FULL=1 npx vitest run
scripts.vercel:setup: echo 'Link Vercel Postgres + KV from the Vercel dashboard, then run npm run db:push'
